title: From Events to Reasoning: Hierarchical Rule Composition over Explicit States
abstract: arXiv:2610.22403v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: What a reasoning system emits is a conclusion; what it owes is a justification. Producing one requires every operation to be admissible on the facts actually available, the dependencies of intermediate results to survive to the end of the path, and the path to be revised when a premise changes. We present the Event Reasoning System (ERS), in which the reasoning state is an explicit event graph. Semantic features nominate candidate objects and rule bindings, and declared rule and task conditions decide which may execute, so candidates that violate the represented period, unit, or evidence constraints cannot enter an accepted reasoning path. Low-level rules provide reusable local transformations, and recursively composable high-level control rules organize subgoals and legal paths under the current goal, information gaps, and budget; a finite library is thereby rebound into paths never stored as complete solutions. translated_title: 从事件到推理：显式状态上的层次化规则组合
translated_abstract: 推理系统所输出的是结论，而它所亏欠的是论证。要产出结论，需要每一步操作都在实际可得的事实上是可允许的，中间结果的依赖关系能够维持到路径终点，并且当前提发生变化时推理路径能够被修正。我们提出了事件推理系统（ERS），其中推理状态是一个显式的事件图。语义特征负责提名候选对象和规则绑定，而声明的规则条件与任务条件决定哪些候选可以执行，因此违反了所表示的时期、单位或证据约束的候选无法进入被接受的推理路径。低层规则提供可复用的局部变换，递归可组合的高层控制规则则在当前目标、信息缺口和预算之下组织子目标与合法路径；由此，一个有限的规则库可以被重新绑定成从未作为完整解存储过的推理路径。我们对可允许的……
tldr: 该论文提出事件推理系统（ERS），将推理状态表示为显式事件图，通过低层局部变换规则与递归可组合的高层控制规则的层次化组合，生成每步操作均可溯源论证、且前提变化时可修正的推理路径。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes the Event Reasoning System (ERS), which represents the reasoning state as an explicit event graph and uses hierarchical composition of low-level local transformation rules and recursively composable high-level control rules to produce reasoning paths whose every operation is justified by actually available facts and revisable when premises change.
